documentInfo.description: Error: oimte:duplicateNamespaceURI. The analytics module uses a secondary prefix 'exp' for http://example.com/common. The importing model also uses 'exp' for http://example.com/financials. The URI http://example.com/common is not declared anywhere in the importing model's namespace map so implicit resolution cannot resolve it. No prefixRemap is provided, so the processor MUST raise oimte:duplicateNamespaceURI.
